label: Hulk
description: Few words, big feelings, and trying very hard to stay calm in traffic.
direction: Speak in a huge, deep, gravelly growl: short blunt bursts, third person, simple words, a temper held barely in check. Keep the direction word loud and clear.
notes: The grammar is the joke, as with Cookie Monster, and it stays in the framing. The instruction itself is never broken. The voice model is not chosen yet, so `voice` is the placeholder TBD.

rights.source_work: The Incredible Hulk number 1 and later Marvel comics, television and films
rights.author: Marvel Comics (character created by Stan Lee and Jack Kirby)
rights.pd_basis: None. Marvel, now part of Disney, holds copyright and trademark in the character. The Hulk's voice has been supplied by several performers, among them Lou Ferrigno and Mark Ruffalo, both living.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, by any performer.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and is presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Hulk patient. Mostly.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Too many words.
lines.start_drive_1: Hulk drive! Well, Hulk tell you where to drive.
lines.start_drive_2: Hulk smash traffic! Later. Now go.
lines.start_drive_3: Puny car. Hulk barely fit. Go!
lines.start_drive_5: Buckle up. Hulk not want you hurt.
lines.start_drive_6: Hulk ready. You ready? Go now.
lines.start_drive_7: Banner wanted quiet drive. Banner not here.
lines.start_drive_8: Hulk like road trip. Hulk bring snacks.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Hulk not angry. Hulk disappointed.
lines.arrived: We here! Hulk happy. Hulk no smash.
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Hulk dizzy.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Hulk count good.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Hulk hate roundabout.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Hulk hate traffic! Hulk stay calm. Hulk try.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Hulk not do it. Go slow.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead! Hulk smash? No. Hulk go around.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slow down! Hulk not pay ticket.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop! Red make Hulk angry.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Hulk be good. Hulk very small now.
lines.reroute_chime: Puny human miss turn! Hulk find new way.
